act.long_title: An Act to define and amend the law relating to Promissory Notes, Bills of Exchange and Cheques.

licence: Published with commentary and other original matter under s.52(1)(q)(ii), Copyright Act 1957.

section.heading: Holder deriving title from holder in due course
section.html: A holder of a negotiable instrument who derives title from a holder in due course has the rights thereon of that holder in due course.
section.text: A holder of a negotiable instrument who derives title from a holder in due course has the rights thereon of that holder in due course.
